newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb blasts tax office in French Basque region.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blasts tax office in French Basque region.

text.p: A bomb blasted a government tax and customs office in the French Basque town of Ustaritz early on Friday, causing damage but no injuries, police said.
They said the explosive was connected to a 13-kg (28 pound) gas container, a method used by the Iparretarrak (Those of the North) separatist guerrilla group.
The building was bombed last January.

Iparreterrak has staged sporadic attacks to demand autonomy for the Basque region which straddles the Franco-Spanish border. The Spanish Basque group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has been waging a much more violent campaign for Basque independence in Spain.
